lean.fidelity_note: Theorem 1.1 treats centred Gaussian Hamiltonians satisfying (1.3) for a three-times continuously differentiable, even ξ with ξ(0) = 0 and ξ″(x) > 0 for x > 0. Lean assumes β > 0 and covariance exactly Nβ²R²/2 at each size. In the off-diagonal model (1.1), the normalized covariance error β²/(2N) is removed by adding the same independent centred Gaussian of variance β²/2 to every energy, which preserves the expected log partition function.
